items.title: Geometric Arch Grid — Ochre / Gray / Black

items.title: Mint-Cyan Compact Glow Line Overlay
items.prompt:
PURE GRAPHIC MOTIF MATERIAL ONLY. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI screenshot, no app icon, no product mockup, no finished poster, no photography, no people.

Refinement target: keep the current approved two-line shape and stroke thickness, but remove the light-trail feeling. Replace the over-bright cyan trail with a calmer cyan-mint mixed luminous line treatment. The result should feel like refined graphic linework, not long-exposure photography or motion trails.

1:1 square, flat 2D editorial graphic material. Background: deep charcoal / near-black warm graphite with subtle paper-plaster grain, refined and tactile, not pure digital black.

Linework: exactly two dominant curved lines, preserving the same broad shallow arc composition, same smooth controlled curvature, same medium-thick stroke weight, and same calm diagonal flow as the current candidate. Color treatment: cyan mixed with soft mint green, with a restrained luminous edge. Use a cleaner solid glowing stroke core rather than a trailing blur. The glow should be present but compact and controlled: small soft halo close to the line, no long streaks, no motion blur, no light painting, no photographic light trail. Subtle warm amber/clay edge may remain very faint, but mint-cyan should be the main feeling.

Important correction: SAME LINE SHAPE, SAME LINE THICKNESS, LESS LIGHT-TRAIL FEELING, CYAN + MINT MIX. Do not add extra lines. Do not make the lines wavy. Do not make the lines thinner or thicker. Do not make worm-like, snake-like, caterpillar-like, biological, lumpy, segmented, rubbery, or overly organic curves.

General constraints: ONLY TWO MAIN LINES. No complete circles, no centered badge/seal, no icon, no object, no UI, no map/route diagram, no orbit clutter, no dots/dashes/arrows, no fake labels. Keep it line-only: no filled shapes, no blobs, no color blocks, no surface patches, no 3D object, no glass lens. No extra secondary line clusters. No decorative scratches.

Success criteria: dark background, same two-line shape and thickness as previous approved candidate, calmer cyan-mint luminous line, compact glow without light-trail/motion-blur feeling, text-free, flat 2D, refined, usable as a brand/package/UI overlay material.
